parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State five actions performed during purification (wudu).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain the circumstances when Muslims may not need to make purification (wudu) before
prayer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
To what extent are purification (wudu) and prayer (salah) connected? Give reasons to support
your answer. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State five businesses or trades which Muslims should avoid.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the conditions necessary for trade and business transactions in Islam.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Honesty is the most important requirement for trade in Islam.’ Do you agree? Discuss this
statement with reference to different points of view. 
Section B
Answer EITHER Question 3 OR Question 4.
EITHER

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the importance of ʿAli for Shiʾi Muslims.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess the importance of the Prophet’s family for Sunni and Shi’i Muslims. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain different Muslim views about predestination (qadar).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Muslims are not able to influence their future.’ Do you agree? Discuss this statement with
reference to different points of view.
